quests.name: A Parcel for the Barber
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Sarnwick to the barber.
intro: This should have gone to the barber days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the banker.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Food Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the food shop keeper of Sarnwick and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the food shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The general store keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Sarnwick Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Sarnwick Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Sarnwick Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Spiders
quests.summary: The sword shop keeper wants the spider near Sarnwick thinned out.
intro: The spider beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 10 of them close to Sarnwick and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Oak Logs
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper of Sarnwick has run out of oak logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 16 oak logs and nobody in Sarnwick has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Sword Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Sarnwick to the sword shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the sword shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the magic shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Sarnwick and bring back raw salmon.
intro: The wilds around Sarnwick need a firm hand. Start with 10 spider outside the walls, then 16 giant spider down in Sarnwick Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 16 raw salmon to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Sarnwick for the general store keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the magic shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The general store keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the clothes shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the magic shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Sarnwick Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Sarnwick Sewers and tell the banker.
intro: Sarnwick Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 16 of them, then let the banker know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Sarnwick owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Sarnwick Sewers is clearer than it was. 16 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Eloreach
quests.summary: Gather iron bar for the sword shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Eloreach.
intro: I have an order from Eloreach and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 10 iron bar, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the sword shop keeper in Sarnwick.
From Sarnwick? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt (Archery Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Sarnwick and bring back willow logs.
intro: The wilds around Sarnwick need a firm hand. Start with 10 bat outside the walls, then 16 cave slime down in Sarnwick Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 20 willow logs to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.summary: Gather raw trout for the food shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Eloreach.

outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the food shop keeper in Sarnwick.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Sarnwick
quests.summary: Find what rules Sarnwick Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Plague Warden.
intro: Something rules Sarnwick Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the armour shop keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Sarnwick is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Plague Warden.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Plague Warden is dead. Sarnwick Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Frostbite Cavern, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Frostbite Cavern has stood against Sarnwick for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the general store keeper, fight your way through 24 giant spider and end The Broodmother.
Bring 12 bones back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Frostbite Cavern?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Sarnwick: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Sarnwick Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Sarnwick and Eloreach.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Eloreach. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 24 spider near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the food shop keeper underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the banker in Sarnwick.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Eloreach is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Sarnwick has not had news this good in years.
